outline:
開課：機電、製科所合開（下學期）(含一般生、在職生)
本課程說明RFID系統架構，技術、編碼、和應用標準，資訊系統，效益評估，隱私權問題，及各領域或產業的創新應用和案例。
schedule:
week 1	Class open and course intro
week 2	Technology overview
week 3	Technology overview
week 4	Retail applications,Technology overview
week 5	Healthcare applications, Advantages and limitations
week 6	Exam 1
week 7	No Class
week 8	CPG applications, Application types
week 9	Midterm
week 10	Manufacturing applications, Application types
week 11	Logistics applications, Privacy/Security
week 12	Defense applications, EPC and standard
week 13	Packaging applications, RFID vs Barcode
week 14	Pharma applications, project presentation
week 15	Aerospace	 applications, project presenta
week 16	Project presentation
week 17	Project presentation
week 18  Final exam week
assessment:
Exam 1 (25%)
Mid-term (25%)
Team project (25%)
Class performance – questions, express, and presentations (25%)
